websites.title: AIME 2024: plain revision reaches the ceiling
websites.coverage: 18/18 calibration answers; six questions; no review arms
websites.full_finding: All 18 calibration answers completed in the expected format. Sonnet originals scored 5/6 (83.3%); plain Sonnet revision and Terra alone each scored 6/6 (100%). Plain revision repaired one answer with no regressions, gaining 16.7 percentage points. Cross-model review was not run, so its effect is unmeasured.
websites.features: Scored evidence, coverage, limitations and test assessment

websites.title: BBEH: exact-answer and runtime suitability screen
websites.coverage: 22/36 calibration answers received; main comparison absent
websites.summary: A: 4/12 planned, 7 missing; B: 3/12 planned, 7 missing; E: 7/12 planned, 0 missing
websites.full_finding: Two Sonnet originals timed out at 180 seconds, one in Multistep Arithmetic and one in Hyperbaton. The controller session ended with four active calls unresolved and they were reconciled as missing. Terra completed 12 answers; the full A/B/E calibration is incomplete, so no benchmark score or review comparison exists.
websites.features: Scored evidence, coverage, limitations and test assessment

websites.title: BBEH: harder questions, an unsuccessful suitability screen
websites.coverage: 22/36 calibration answers received; main comparison not run
websites.summary: A: 1/12 planned, 7 missing; B: 1/12 planned, 7 missing; E: 3/12 planned, 0 missing
websites.full_finding: Terra completed 12/12 calibration answers and scored 3/12 (25%) under the official scorer. Sonnet completed five originals, with one correct; seven originals timed out at 120 seconds. Its five available plain revisions also had one correct, with seven dependent revisions blocked. The controller stopped after 29 calls; the conditional 168-call main comparison did not run.
websites.features: Scored evidence, coverage, limitations and test assessment

websites.title: PlanBench Hard: Sonnet/Terra workflows and practical impact
websites.summary: A: 48/50 evaluated, 0 missing; B: 50/50 evaluated, 0 missing; C: 50/50 evaluated, 0 missing; D: 50/50 evaluated, 0 missing
websites.full_finding: Sonnet originals scored 48/50 (96%). Plain revision, Sonnet self-review, and Terra review followed by Sonnet revision each scored 50/50 (100%). The two original plans executed legally but failed to satisfy the complete goal; all three revision approaches fixed them. Terra review added 0 points over either revision control and 4 points over the original draft.
websites.features: Scored evidence, coverage, limitations and test assessment

websites.title: PlanBench Hard: scored workflows and practical impact
websites.summary: A: 50/50 evaluated, 0 missing; B: 50/50 evaluated, 0 missing; C: 50/50 evaluated, 0 missing; D: 45/45 evaluated, 5 missing
websites.full_finding: Original Astra, plain revision and self-review each produced 50/50 valid plans (100%). Fable review delivered 45/50 plans: 45 valid, 0 invalid and 5 missing. Cross-model review gained zero points on the jointly evaluated tasks. With the missing outcomes unresolved, its full-cohort score can only be 90–100.
websites.features: Scored evidence, coverage, limitations and test assessment

websites.title: Custom planning: promising average scores, judge-dependent conclusions
websites.metric: Mean rubric points, by AI judge
websites.summary: Exploratory rubric gains; material disagreement between judges. No executed-task accuracy or productivity measurement.
websites.full_finding: Across 18 cross-model workflows, post-hoc equal-brief mean gains over drafts were +7.48 Astra and +5.58 Fable points; over matched self-review, +4.08 and +1.94. The predeclared Sonnet-with-Terra contrast was +9.00 Astra but -1.00 Fable over five paired briefs. These are rubric points, not productivity percentages.
websites.features: Scored evidence, coverage, limitations and test assessment

websites.title: SWE-bench: observed workflow gains with important comparison limits
websites.coverage: 50-task subset; current and interim rows have separate denominators
websites.summary: Completed light cohort: A: 39/50, B: 42/50, E: 33/50. Other cohorts and tools differ.
websites.full_finding: The completed base50-light rows report Sonnet solo at 39/50 (78%), Sonnet followed by Terra at 42/50 (84%), and Terra solo at 33/50 (66%). The first two differ by three solved tasks, or six percentage points. Other rows include partial samples and different run cohorts.
